title: the whale strike — the boot warm-up never compiles the canvas page

the_incident.what: the 109-seat certification census (first ride of this window, on the committed t1169 tree) went 105 GREEN / 4 RED — all four REDs in the live-leg lane (t1022 fuel-face socket error, t1023+t1024 FATAL the-server-never-answered-200, t1164 takehome python leg URLError Connection refused)
the_incident.root_cause: dmesg: `Out of memory: Killed process 795 (next-server (v1) total-vm:66011320kB, anon-rss:3379696kB` — the kernel's GLOBAL OOM; the server log showed `[warmup] boot routes precompiled: … / 200` with `GET / 200 in 58s (compile: 58s)` — the app's own boot warmup (src/instrumentation.ts, t427) fetched "/" at every boot and the canvas page's dev compile is a ~3.4 GB RESIDENCY the launcher's 2048 MB heap cap cannot reach (the cap bounds the V8 heap; the whale's compiled graph stays resident outside it); the census's live-lane law (t927: the canvas page is NEVER compiled by the census) had ONE mouth — the census never requests the page — while the warmup compiled it anyway on every boot the census made
the_incident.the_earlier_war_reframed: t1169's cap ladder (896 → 1536 → 2048) was fighting THIS whale without naming it — the strikes attributed the OOM to API-route compiles and raised the cap until the whale's compile survived; its residency then sank the ride anyway

the_cure: src/instrumentation.ts: the "/" warm is gone; the warmup rides the API lane only (jobs · log · projects · ai/settings · judge-worker); the canvas compiles when a real visitor opens it, once, on demand; the law now has TWO mouths (the census never requests the page, the boot never compiles it)

live_rides.chunk_verdict: the ChunkLoadError seen in rides #1–#3 (Lazy session-report-dialog chunk) is the STALE-TAB ARTIFACT — the agent-browser daemon's long-lived tab held an old webpack runtime across server restarts; after console --clear + a fresh navigation the console is CLEAN (dev-noise lines only) and page errors are EMPTY; the old chunk name 404s in the current dev build as expected

judge_lines: 「一法两嘴」: a law with one mouth is a wish — the census's live-lane law said the whale never compiles while the app's own warmup compiled it at every boot; the cure gives the law its second mouth
「热身不能杀死服务器」: a warm-up that OOMs the box it warms is not a warm-up — the first-hit latency of a page nobody is visiting is not worth 3.4 GB of residency
「帽够不到的地方，帽不是墙」: the 2048 MB heap cap bounds the V8 heap, not the residency — the whale's compiled graph lives outside the bound, so the only cure that fits the box is not building the whale at boot
「旧标签的枪声不立案」: the ChunkLoadError was the stale tab's old runtime shooting across server restarts — a fresh console is the verdict, the accumulated buffer is not evidence
platform_notes: the boundary reaper took the between-calls server once (ride #1's ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED) — the whole ride lives in ONE call (tool-results/ride-t1170.sh, the orchestrate-final.sh shape); agent-browser's navigation can time out inside a 40+s first compile — poll the snapshot instead of trusting the open
